purpose: Drive one canonical commerce order through inventory reservation, test capture, shipment, completion, full refund, and physical return.
environment_policy: local, demo, or disposable test tenant only

inputs.canonical_sku: ACTIVE in the same-tenant canonical Catalog

flow: place one multi-line-capable canonical order with one selected SKU line
reserve 2 and bind the reservation to the canonical order item
capture the exact payable amount through INTERNAL_TEST
confirm payment, ship inventory, ship and complete the order
confirm refund, return 2 inventory units, and close the order as RETURNED
replay every command and require immutable duplicate results
invariants: all commands use Admin REST and share one run_id
the order references an ACTIVE canonical SKU and every order item has one reservation
Money uses CNY integer minor units and order, capture, and refund amounts match
refund uses the same provider as capture and is full-only in the first slice
refund success does not restore inventory; a separate RETURN command is required
every state transition emits one versioned Outbox event
replay creates no new order, payment, inventory, transaction, history, or event rows
cleanup: none; retain the run-scoped balance, state history, transactions, and Outbox as immutable evidence
